title: Share
alt: One child’s hand passes a marker to another over an open box of markers.
scene: Close view of two children’s hands over an open box of colored markers. One hand calmly passes a single marker to the other hand; no pulling.
prompt: Use case: educational child-friendly illustration. Bright, simple flat artwork with large clear shapes, light ivory background, friendly to six-year-olds. Square single concept composition. Close view of two children’s hands over an open box of colored markers. One hand calmly passes a single marker to the other hand; no pulling. Children visibly differ in skin tone, hair and build. No adult towering over a child, pointing, shaming or dominating. No prohibition signs, red slashes or crossed-out symbols. Absolutely no words, letters, numerals, writing, captions, labels, logos or watermark; paper and walls must be blank. The native application will add editable captions.
